description: WorldPop 2020 children estimates aggregated from 100 m to a 1 km grid (30 arc-second, 10 x 10 native cells) as GeoParquet polygons, EPSG:4326. Columns pop_0_4, pop_5_9, pop_10_14, pop_15_19, pop_0_19 (children) and pop_total (all ages, from WorldPop jam_ppp_2020_constrained, dataset 49810); n_cells counts the settled 100 m cells summed. 6,062 cells with at least one settled 100 m cell. This is the layer to join spatially with a hurricane cone or any polygon in DuckDB; sums over the whole grid reproduce the raster totals (845,823 children aged 0-19; 2,783,567 people). Modelled estimates, not a census count: WorldPop disaggregates census/projection totals to 100 m cells with a Random-Forest dasymetric model constrained to built settlements. Values are fractional people per cell.
